title: Kit Green could not get read into the autopsy program

tellings.quote: Well, the story I heard was that Kit Green basically had been read in on most of it, but he couldn't get read in on the the autopsy thing

plain: Kit Green, a former CIA scientist, is said to have been "read in", meaning formally cleared, on most of the government's secret UFO work, but he could never get cleared for the part dealing with autopsies. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron tells Michels this as "the story I heard", passing on what was said about Green. If it is true, even a trusted insider was kept out of one sealed-off corner of the work.
